sources.lavalle1855: https://archive.org/details/histoireetstat00unse (Lavalle, Histoire et statistique de la vigne et des grands vins de la Côte-d'Or, 1855; 1972 Geisweiler facsimile; page numbers are the 1855 pagination). Commune lists p.86-161; cross-commune 'Essai de classement' p.162-164. Cross-checked against Danguy & Aubertin 1892 'D. L.' entries.
sources.comite1860: Comité d'agriculture de Beaune, Plan statistique des vignobles produisant les grands vins de Bourgogne (Batault-Morot, 1861), as tabulated climat-by-climat ('C. A. B.') in R. Danguy & Ch. Aubertin, Les grands vins de Bourgogne (la Côte-d'Or), 1892 – https://archive.org/details/vindebourgognela00unse (catalogued on archive.org under Rodier's title, but the scan is Danguy & Aubertin 1892). Gaps filled from https://monocepage.com/category/classementshistoriques/ tables (marked in notes). North of Vougeot the plan's ranks came from 'une société de viticulteurs' of the Dijon arrondissement.
sources.rodier1920: Camille Rodier, Le Vin de Bourgogne (1920), via the commune tables at https://monocepage.com/category/classementshistoriques/ (e.g. https://monocepage.com/vin-bourgogne-classements-historiques-volnay/, /vin-bourgogne-classements-historiques-jules-lavalle-beaune/, /nuits-st-georges-primeaux-prissey/, /morey-st-denis-finage/). Rodier's own text was not available online; his capitalised climats are shown as tête de cuvée.
